report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Sampled traces show all checkout/order/dependency spans returning 200 ok, and metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. Deployment record only proves baseline 1.0.0 exists and cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No current evidence establishes a bounded cause; hand off for error telemetry and the v2.0.0 deployment record.
missing_evidence: Traces/logs showing actual checkout errors (all sampled traces return 200 ok; no error spans observed)
Error-rate or 5xx metrics for checkout/order over the incident window
Deployment record for version 2.0.0 (only baseline 1.0.0 recorded) and its timing relative to errors
Logs (ev-...-order-logs excluded) to characterize any failure mode
